verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Failure handling is especially complete: failed tasks are shown as never cached, blocking dependents, and returning logs to developer or CI. The scheduler and cache-miss execution flow are also strongly covered.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: R13 does not unambiguously enforce publication only after task success; the diagram separates failure from publication but shows publication leading to the success outcome rather than an explicit success gate preceding publication.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board represents nearly the entire requested monorepo build-and-cache contract, including graph expansion, dependency scheduling, elastic parallel execution, key construction, remote-cache lookup and restore, isolated miss execution, immutable artifacts, failure semantics, provenance, and same-key convergence. Three system-defining requirements are partial: the change detector lacks an explicit modified-files input (R2), success-before-publication is not explicitly ordered (R13), and the trust gate omits the specific untrusted-fork/protected-build boundary (R18). No requirement is absent or contradicted, so no cap applies.
